title: Top floor one bedroom plus office
body:
Top floor one bedroom plus office apartment in a Victorian building located near Valencia and 19th. In-unit laundry. Unit is on the third floor of a three floor building. The first bedroom fits king bed +a separate room can be used as office.

**Photos of a similar apartment in the same building to show how the room can look like with furniture; furniture do not come with the apartment.
****************************************************

• Stainless steel appliances and quartz counter top
• Dishwasher, gas stove
• In unit washer and dryer
• Engineered wood floor throughout entire unit
• Bay windows facing a quiet side street off Valencia
• Bathroom has a shower over tub
• Shared bike rack in backyard

****************************************************
Neighborhood:
• Location! 5 minute walk to Dolores Park, BART station at 16th and Mission, and tech company buses. Easy access to 280 and 101.
• Situated in a quiet street off the Valencia Mission Dolores corridor
• Around the corner to restaurants, coffee houses & dessert places - walk score of 99

******************************************************************************
Other details:
• No parking available in building
• Non-smoking unit
• Renter’s insurance required
• Tenant pays for all utilities; rent does not include utilities
• Available now
• 12 month lease
• Security deposit is 1 month's rent
• 1 small dog or 1 cat will be considered (dog must be under 30 pounds and no aggressive breeds) with additional pet deposit and pet rent of $50 per pet per month
• For number of occupants more than 2, additional $400 rent per additional occupant to cover wear and tear.
• Rent controlled unit


************************************************************************************
How to apply:
1. One page application, available via email
2. $30 application fee per occupant

Showing detail:
Please email or text for showing appointment and indicate number of occupants. Virtual video available before scheduling in-person tour.

title: Brand new 1 bedroom - Mission - Quiet, Sunlight, laundry
body:
Junior 1 bedroom - Mission. Quiet, lots of sunlight! Laundry

Junior 1-Bedroom * Brand-new unit, never used * New kitchen with all new appliances, including microwave * Long hallway * Hardwood floors * Good natural sunlight and apartment lighting * Good closet space * Secured building * On-site laundry * Storage closet * Close to all public transportation * Bathroom with shower and tub

Apt is available July 1st

ABOUT THE APARTMENT:
This is a very nice, brand-new junior 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom that can also be a small 2-bedroom. Located in the exciting Mission District and one block from Van Ness. Nice new kitchen with all-new appliances, including a microwave. It has polished hardwood floors throughout. There is a long hallway for art and paintings. Great sunlight and closet space. Also, a storage closet. Coin-operated laundry in the building.

LOCATION: 1750 Mission Street, Apt. 10, San Francisco, CA. 94103 (Cross Street Duboce)

PLEASE READ CAREFULLY AND FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS WHEN CONTACTING:
Contact: Call or text Sason anytime

* We can also provide a video via WhatsApp to start. You can message me using my number, and I will send you the video. Virtual tours available for out-of-town tenants

Live in the hip and vibrant Mission District! The apartment is very conveniently located, just 1 block from Van Ness, 13th, and Duboce, and a few blocks from the exciting Valencia Street. Close to many restaurants, bars, cafes, and shopping! The world-famous Rainbow Vegetarian Market is only a few blocks away. Whole Foods and Safeway are also nearby. There is a Target 2 blocks away and a Costco. Close to all transportation, including Muni lines 49 and 14, only half a block away, and very close to BART!

Nice brand new junior 1 bedroom (can act as a small 2 bedroom)

1 new bathroom with tub and shower
Beautiful, new hardwood floors
Beautiful new kitchen with all new appliances, including a microwave

A Cat is okay, NO DOGS.
